scientific_integrity: The statement is an exact deterministic bound and a sharp minimax mesh placement for four-knot, fixed-position, nondecreasing-data PCHIP interpolation; symbolic identities are proved analytically and exact-fraction tests provide nonproof corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Interior four-point PCHIP cell only; it does not give the endpoint-slope sensitivity of finite-grid PCHIP.
Both input data vectors are nondecreasing, with fixed knots.
Worst-case deterministic point perturbation coefficient, not a stochastic accuracy guarantee.
Historical originality remains provisional; related original PCHIP subdivision and nonuniform spline work has not all been available as full text.
title: Sharp local noise amplification and optimal mesh balancing for nonuniform PCHIP
